title: 維也納污水處理能源自給計畫~Vienna wastewater energy self-sufficiency project
focus: 污泥碳分配與能源自給邊界~Sludge-carbon allocation and energy-self-sufficiency boundary
summary: 以維也納E_OS為案例，將水線需氧與污泥產氣放在同一能量帳；先看出水要求，再比較有機物進曝氣或消化的不同去向。~Using Vienna E_OS, put liquid-line oxygen demand and sludge gas recovery in one energy ledger; meet effluent needs before comparing carbon sent to aeration or digestion.

units.title: 進廠有機碳入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Incoming organic-carbon boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「進廠有機碳入口」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at incoming organic-carbon boundary.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「進廠有機碳入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for incoming organic-carbon boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「進廠有機碳入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the incoming organic-carbon boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 初沉碳捕集：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Primary carbon capture: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「初沉碳捕集」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at primary carbon capture.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初沉碳捕集」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary carbon capture; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「初沉碳捕集」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the primary carbon capture measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 濃縮污泥輸送：乾固體與含水率~Thickened-sludge transfer: Dry solids and moisture
units.mechanism: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「濃縮污泥輸送」觀察此因果關係。~Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at thickened-sludge transfer.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
units.verify: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「濃縮污泥輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for thickened-sludge transfer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。~All wet-mass reduction during dewatering is destroyed pollution.
units.practice: 先點選「濃縮污泥輸送」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the thickened-sludge transfer measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 消化槽固體收支：揮發性固體消化~Digester solids balance: Volatile-solids digestion
units.mechanism: 厭氧消化將一部分可降解有機固體轉為氣體；惰性固體保留在消化污泥內。本單元在「消化槽固體收支」觀察此因果關係。~Anaerobic digestion converts part of degradable volatile solids to gas; inert solids remain in digestate. Examine this relationship at digester solids balance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進料乾固體3000 kg/d、VS分率0.70、VS破壞率0.50。公式 VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η；代入 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d。適用邊界：假想穩態質量帳，實際破壞率須以進出料完整固體收支估算。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: feed dry solids3000 kg/d, VS fraction0.70 and VS destruction0.50. Formula VSdestroyed=MDS fVS η; substitution 3000*0.70*0.50 = 1050 kg VS/d. Boundary: Hypothetical steady balance; actual destruction needs complete input/output solids accounting.
units.verify: 測進出料TS與VS並檢查貯槽累積，避免以濃度差代替質量差。在離線場景為「消化槽固體收支」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. Build an offline evidence table for digester solids balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 灰分也能在厭氧消化中全部變成甲烷。~All ash can turn into methane during anaerobic digestion.
units.practice: 先點選「消化槽固體收支」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把VS破壞率改成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1260 kg VS/d。與基準 1050 kg VS/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the digester solids balance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only VS destruction to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1260 kg VS/d. Compare with baseline 1050 kg VS/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 沼氣理論與實收：COD與甲烷理論潛力~Theoretical and collected gas: COD and theoretical methane potential
units.mechanism: 電子當量可把被轉化COD連結到甲烷的理論體積；細胞合成、溶解甲烷與洩漏使實收量較低。本單元在「沼氣理論與實收」觀察此因果關係。~Electron equivalence links converted COD to theoretical methane volume; growth, dissolved methane and leaks reduce collected gas. Examine this relationship at theoretical and collected gas.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：已轉化COD=1000 kg/d、理論上限0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD。公式 VCH4=0.35 CODconverted；代入 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Nm³採0°C、1atm基準；上限計量而非廠商產氣保證。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: converted COD=1000 kg/d and theoretical upper factor0.35 Nm³ CH₄/kg COD. Formula VCH4=0.35 CODconverted; substitution 0.35*1000 = 350 Nm³ CH₄/d. Boundary: Nm³ uses0°C and1atm; stoichiometric upper bound, not a supplier guarantee.
units.verify: 將氣量修正到同一溫壓，量測甲烷分率與溶解排出。在離線場景為「沼氣理論與實收」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Normalize gas volume to the same temperature/pressure and measure methane fraction and dissolved losses. Build an offline evidence table for theoretical and collected gas; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把總沼氣量當純甲烷量會高估可用熱值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Treating total biogas as pure methane overestimates energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 所有COD移除都會轉為可收集甲烷。~Every unit of removed COD becomes collected methane.
units.practice: 先點選「沼氣理論與實收」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把已轉化COD改成800 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 280 Nm³ CH₄/d。與基準 350 Nm³ CH₄/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the theoretical and collected gas measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only converted COD to800 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 280 Nm³ CH₄/d. Compare with baseline 350 Nm³ CH₄/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 污泥換熱器：污泥加熱與熱回收~Sludge heat exchanger: Sludge heating and heat recovery
units.mechanism: 顯熱需求取決於質量、比熱與溫差；預熱回收降低外加熱但不改變最終溫度目標的熱力學收支。本單元在「污泥換熱器」觀察此因果關係。~Sensible heat depends on mass, heat capacity and temperature difference; recovery reduces external heat without changing the thermodynamic duty. Examine this relationship at sludge heat exchanger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10000 kg/d、cp=4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、ΔT=20 K。公式 Qheat=m cp ΔT/3600；代入 10000*4.18*20/3600 = 232.2222 kWh/d。適用邊界：以水近似污泥比熱；不含相變與槽壁損失。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: m=10000 kg/d, cp=4.18 kJ/(kg·K) andΔT=20 K. Formula Qheat=m cp ΔT/3600; substitution 10000*4.18*20/3600 = 232.2222 kWh/d. Boundary: Water-like heat capacity assumed; phase change and wall losses excluded.
units.verify: 量測進出溫度及流量，區分換熱回收與燃料投入。在離線場景為「污泥換熱器」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure inlet/outlet temperatures and flow, distinguishing recovered heat from fuel input. Build an offline evidence table for sludge heat exchanger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 換熱器結垢使熱端溫度上升但冷端升溫不足。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Fouling can raise hot-side temperature while providing insufficient cold-side heating. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 有熱回收就不再需要能量平衡。~Heat recovery removes the need for an energy balance.
units.practice: 先點選「污泥換熱器」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把溫差改成15 K，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 174.1667 kWh/d。與基準 232.2222 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sludge heat exchanger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only temperature difference to15 K with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 174.1667 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 232.2222 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 沼氣熱電機組：沼氣熱電聯產~Biogas CHP unit: Biogas combined heat and power
units.mechanism: 甲烷化學能在機組中分成電、可用熱與損失；發電效率不能與總利用效率混稱。本單元在「沼氣熱電機組」觀察此因果關係。~Methane energy splits into electricity, usable heat and losses; electrical efficiency differs from total utilization. Examine this relationship at biogas CHP unit.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：甲烷500 Nm³/d、低位熱值9.94 kWh/Nm³、發電效率0.35。公式 Eel=V LHV ηel；代入 500*9.94*0.35 = 1739.5 kWh/d。適用邊界：假想機組固定效率；未扣輔機電力，熱能另計。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: methane500 Nm³/d, lower heating value9.94 kWh/Nm³ and electrical efficiency0.35. Formula Eel=V LHV ηel; substitution 500*9.94*0.35 = 1739.5 kWh/d. Boundary: Fixed hypothetical efficiency; auxiliaries are not deducted and heat is separate.
units.verify: 以燃氣能量帳對照總發電、輸出電與供熱三個表。在離線場景為「沼氣熱電機組」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare fuel energy with gross electricity, exported electricity and delivered heat meters. Build an offline evidence table for biogas CHP unit; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把發電與廠內耗電相加當外售量會重複計數。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Adding generation and internal consumption as exports double counts energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 熱電聯產可同時把全部燃料能量變成電又變成熱。~CHP can convert all fuel energy separately into both electricity and heat.
units.practice: 先點選「沼氣熱電機組」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把發電效率改成0.30，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1491 kWh/d。與基準 1739.5 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the biogas CHP unit measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only electrical efficiency to0.30 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1491 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1739.5 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 水線曝氣需求：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Liquid-line aeration demand: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「水線曝氣需求」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at liquid-line aeration demand.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「水線曝氣需求」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for liquid-line aeration demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「水線曝氣需求」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the liquid-line aeration demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 全廠電力邊界：淨電力與廠用負載~Whole-plant electricity boundary: Net electricity and auxiliary loads
units.mechanism: 能源自給須以同一邊界比較可用發電與所有廠用電；年度淨額不代表每小時離網。本單元在「全廠電力邊界」觀察此因果關係。~Energy self-sufficiency compares usable generation and all internal loads within one boundary; an annual net balance does not prove hourly islanded operation. Examine this relationship at whole-plant electricity boundary.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：發電5000 kWh/d、曝氣2800、泵600、其他400 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother；代入 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d。適用邊界：示範日帳，未含備援燃料與尖峰電力容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: generation5000 kWh/d, aeration2800, pumping600 and other loads400 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother; substitution 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d. Boundary: Illustrative daily ledger; reserve fuel and peak power capacity are omitted.
units.verify: 核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「全廠電力邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for whole-plant electricity boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 年發電量大於用電就證明完全不用外電。~Annual generation above demand proves no grid imports are needed.
units.practice: 先點選「全廠電力邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把曝氣用電提高到3500 kWh/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 500 kWh/d。與基準 1200 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the whole-plant electricity boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 500 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1200 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 能量系統停機情境：備援與共同失效~Energy-system outage scenario: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「能量系統停機情境」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at energy-system outage scenario.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「能量系統停機情境」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for energy-system outage scenario; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「能量系統停機情境」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the energy-system outage scenario measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: ebswien及其研究文獻以污泥處理、消化氣及能量整合說明污水廠能源轉型；教學算例不代表其實測績效。~ebswien and project research describe energy transformation through sludge treatment, biogas and integration; the teaching examples are not measured plant performance.

單元2基準：初沉碳捕集~Unit2 baseline: primary carbon capture
單元2變量實驗：只把面積加至400 m²~Unit2 changed-input experiment: increase only area to400 m²
單元3基準：濃縮污泥輸送~Unit3 baseline: thickened-sludge transfer
單元3變量實驗：只把固體分率提高到0.20~Unit3 changed-input experiment: increase only solids fraction to0.20
單元4基準：消化槽固體收支~Unit4 baseline: digester solids balance
單元4變量實驗：只把VS破壞率改成0.60~Unit4 changed-input experiment: change only VS destruction to0.60
單元5基準：沼氣理論與實收~Unit5 baseline: theoretical and collected gas
單元5變量實驗：只把已轉化COD改成800 kg/d~Unit5 changed-input experiment: change only converted COD to800 kg/d
單元6基準：污泥換熱器~Unit6 baseline: sludge heat exchanger
單元6變量實驗：只把溫差改成15 K~Unit6 changed-input experiment: change only temperature difference to15 K
單元7基準：沼氣熱電機組~Unit7 baseline: biogas CHP unit
單元7變量實驗：只把發電效率改成0.30~Unit7 changed-input experiment: change only electrical efficiency to0.30
單元8基準：水線曝氣需求~Unit8 baseline: liquid-line aeration demand
單元8變量實驗：只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh~Unit8 changed-input experiment: reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh
單元9基準：全廠電力邊界~Unit9 baseline: whole-plant electricity boundary
單元9變量實驗：只把曝氣用電提高到3500 kWh/d~Unit9 changed-input experiment: increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d
單元10基準：能量系統停機情境~Unit10 baseline: energy-system outage scenario
單元10變量實驗：只把各列A改成0.90~Unit10 changed-input experiment: change only each train availability to0.90
